class.label: Class
class.blurb: A class's identity in card terms — what it leans toward.

keepsake.label: Keepsake
keepsake.blurb: The boon you start the run holding.

enemy.label: Enemy
enemy.blurb: Creature identity; gates proc resistance at runtime.

armour.label: Armour
armour.blurb: Armour sets. Ids repeat per class, so classId is part of the key.

slot.label: Slot
slot.blurb: What you can wear, and when you may swap.

effect.label: Effect
effect.blurb: Damage effects carry card tags; a hit inherits the card's identity.

grant.label: Grant
grant.blurb: Where a starting card comes from. No collection: like `effect`, this family exists only to declare a vocabulary — the order bound cards are dealt in.

location.label: Location
location.blurb: Where a run stops: a classic node type (shrine), the Unknown node's camp, an atlas rest service's type (inn, chapel) or one atlas node by id. No collection — the ids are the map's, checked by model/locations.js. Mounted from arrival to departure (engine/locations.js).

companion.label: Companion
companion.blurb: A temporary ally bought at the market (SPEC §14.3). It travels with the run for a number of fights, and what it does is its property rows here, mounted at combat start (engine/properties.js).

sigil.label: Sigil
sigil.blurb: A sigil set into an armament's slot at the blacksmith (SPEC §14.3, §14.4). What it does is its property row here, mounted while its armament is equipped (engine/properties.js).

feat.label: Class feat
feat.blurb: A selected class feat confers mounted property rules.

enemyMove.label: Enemy move
enemyMove.blurb: An authored enemy action; id is scoped by enemyId.
